title: Blok document
description: A saved Blok document: a flat array of blocks. Nesting is expressed by references — a child carries `parent`, its container carries `content` — never by nesting blocks inside each other.

id.description: The document id. Blok writes it on the first save and keeps it.

time.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the document was saved.

version.description: Version of Blok that produced the document.

title.description: The page title. Absent when empty.

icon.description: The page icon. Absent when none. The editor ignores a malformed icon when it loads one; this schema rejects it. Extra keys are allowed, because the editor keeps them.

blocks.description: Every block in the document, in reading order.

id.description: Unique block id. Generated on load when absent.

type.description: Registered tool name. Built-in names are covered by $defs; custom tools are allowed.

data.description: Tool-specific payload. See the $defs entry matching `type`.

tunes.description: Per-tune payloads, keyed by tune name. Unknown tunes are preserved as-is.

parent.description: Id of the containing block. Absent for a root-level block.

content.description: Ids of this block's children, in order. Absent when it has none.

lastEditedAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the last edit to this block.

lastEditedBy.description: Identifier of the user who last edited this block.

oneOf.description: Rich-text segments, in order. Preferred: this is the shape Blok saves.

marks.description: Formatting on one run. A key Blok does not know is dropped on load, except `tag:<name>` keys from custom inline tools.

highlight.description: A highlight with no colour of its own.

color.description: Preset name ("red") or any CSS colour.

background.description: Preset name ("red") or any CSS colour.

html.description: Inline markup the segment model has no slot for, kept verbatim.

isOpen.description: Ignored. Open state is personal and never saved.

anchor.description: Anchor id rendered as the heading element's `id`.

list.description: One list item. A list is a run of sibling `list` blocks, not a single block.

background.description: Preset name ("red") or any CSS colour.

checked.description: Checklist state. Only emitted for style "checklist".

start.description: Starting number of an ordered run. Omitted when 1.

table.description: A grid whose cells reference child blocks by id; the referenced blocks are siblings in `blocks` carrying `parent` = the table id.

withHeadings.description: First row is a heading row.

withHeadingColumn.description: First column is a heading column.

stretched.description: Table spans the full editor width.

anyOf.description: Legacy plain-text cell, still accepted on load.

blocks.description: Ids of the blocks rendered in this cell, in order.

id.description: Column id. Every cell of one column carries the same value.

rowId.description: Row id. Every cell of one row carries the same value.

text.description: Inline HTML mirror of the cell, kept for import/export paths.

colspan.description: Only set on a merge origin.

rowspan.description: Only set on a merge origin.

mergedInto.description: [row, col] of the merge origin covering this cell.

colWidths.description: Column widths in pixels. Omit for equal widths.

initialColWidth.description: Per-column width in pixels captured at creation.

toggle.description: A collapsible summary line. Its body blocks reference it as `parent`.

color.description: Preset name ("red") or any CSS colour.

background.description: Preset name ("red") or any CSS colour.

isOpen.description: Ignored. Open state is personal and never saved.

callout.description: A highlighted panel. Its body blocks reference it as `parent`; the panel itself holds no text.

emoji.description: Leading emoji. Empty string hides it.

textColor.description: Preset name, or null to inherit.

backgroundColor.description: Preset name, or null for none.

database.description: Schema and view configuration only — rows are child `database-row` blocks.

activeViewId.description: Id of the view shown by default.

schema.description: Column definitions. Exactly one must have type "title".

config.description: Type-specific options; select/multiSelect carry their choices here.

groupId.description: Status only: the id of the status group holding this option.

pageVisibility.description: How the row page shows the property. Default always.

date.description: Display of date, created time and last edited time values.

timeZone.description: IANA zone. Absent means the viewer's zone.

groupBy.description: Property id. Required for a board view.

groupByStatus.description: Grouping by a status: one group per status group or per option. Default option.

value.description: Any property value; shape follows the property type.

visibleProperties.description: Visible non-title property ids, in order. Kept in step with `properties` for older readers.

properties.description: Per-property settings in this view; array order is column order. Wins over visibleProperties.

frozenColumnCount.description: Columns from the start that stay put on horizontal scroll. Default 0.

openPagesIn.description: Where a row page opens. Default side; center for gallery.

noValueGroupPosition.description: Where the no-value group sits among the groups. Absent means last.

database-row.description: One row of a database block. Optional pageId points to a separate body document.

properties.description: Column values keyed by property id. Values follow the parent database's schema, so the shape is open.

title.description: Row title, mirrored from the title column. Absent on rows written before this key existed.

pageId.description: Id of the separate document that holds the row page body.

convertedValues.description: Values a property type change could not carry over, keyed by property id; restored if the type changes back.

value.description: The value as the old type stored it.

divider.description: A horizontal rule. Carries no data.

height.description: Gap in pixels. Defaults to 38; out-of-range values are clamped on load.

table_of_contents.description: An outline of the page headings. The list is read from the document each time and never saved.

oneOf.description: Rich-text segments, in order. Preferred: this is the shape Blok saves.

marks.description: Formatting on one run. A key Blok does not know is dropped on load, except `tag:<name>` keys from custom inline tools.

highlight.description: A highlight with no colour of its own.

color.description: Preset name ("red") or any CSS colour.

background.description: Preset name ("red") or any CSS colour.

marks.description: Formatting on one run. A key Blok does not know is dropped on load, except `tag:<name>` keys from custom inline tools.

highlight.description: A highlight with no colour of its own.

color.description: Preset name ("red") or any CSS colour.

background.description: Preset name ("red") or any CSS colour.

code.description: A code block. `code` is raw text, never HTML.

filename.description: File name shown above the code, e.g. "block.ts". Omitted when empty.

variants.description: Every rendition, best format first. Ignored unless it contains `url`, the most compatible one.

naturalWidth.description: Intrinsic pixel width, cached after first load.

crop.description: Non-destructive crop, in percent of the intrinsic image. Omitted for an uncropped rectangle. With `rotation`, `flipX` or `straighten` set, it is in percent of the turned image's box.

rotation.description: Clockwise quarter turn, applied after the mirror. Omitted for 0.

flipX.description: Mirror left to right, before the turn. Omitted for false.

straighten.description: Clockwise degrees, after the turn. Omitted for 0.

filter.description: Colour look: a built-in preset (vivid, noir, sepia, …) or a host filter name from the image tool's `filters` config. Omitted for "none".

filterStrength.description: How strongly `filter` applies. Omitted for 100 and when there is no filter.

adjust.description: Colour adjustments, each -100..100. Zero entries are omitted, and so is an empty object.

markup.description: Drawings, shapes and text over the image, back to front. Omitted when empty. Coordinates are fractions (0..1) of the turned image's box, before crop and straighten. Sizes are fractions of that box's shorter side.

points.description: Flat x, y, pressure triples. Pressure is 0..1.

cut.description: Ends the eraser cut. Omitted when none.

anyOf.description: A shape between two corners. Rect and ellipse fill the box they span; line and arrow join the points.

fill.description: Rect and ellipse only: a translucent fill. Omitted for false.

rotation.description: Star and polygon only: clockwise degrees. Omitted for 0.

tx.description: Bubble only: where the tail points.

text.description: Plain text; a newline breaks the line.

rotation.description: Clockwise degrees about the centre. Omitted for 0.

variants.description: Every rendition, best format first. Ignored unless it contains `url`, the most compatible one.

column_list.description: A row of columns. Carries no data — the columns are its `content` children.

column.description: One column of a column_list. Its content is its `content` children.

widthRatio.description: Width relative to sibling columns. Omitted for an even split.

tabs.description: A set of tabs. Carries no data — the tabs are its `content` children, which are only `tab` blocks. The open tab is not saved.

tab.description: One tab of a tabs block. Its content is its `content` children.

title.description: Plain text, not HTML. Empty for an untitled tab.

icon.description: Emoji shown before the title. Omitted when the tab has none.

embed.description: A live third-party embed. Only registry-matched provider URLs are embedded.
Provider-sanctioned embed URL. Must be https.

bookmark.description: A static link preview card built from OpenGraph metadata.

page.description: A link to a sub-page. The page body lives in a separate document named by `pageId`, not in this one, so the block has no children.

pageId.description: Id of the separate document that holds the page.

page-link.description: A non-owning reference to a page. It has no children.
